stem: What can the reader conclude about LEGO products from this sentence?
instruction:
Read this sentence from the selection.

In fact, a standard-size LEGO brick made today can be attached to any other LEGO brick made since 1958.

options.label: A
options.text: People have shared LEGO sets with friends and family for a long time.

options.label: B
options.text: The basic design of the LEGO has stayed the same.

options.label: C
options.text: LEGO toys made of plastic last longer than those made of wood.

options.label: D
options.text: Ole Kirk Christiansen believed in making LEGO toys that were fun and entertaining.
